original_title:
unix: improve handling of uv_async_send mistakes

original_body:
When the user calls uv_async_send concurrently with uv_loop_close, we try to prevent that data race from actually accessing undefined behavior by setting the pending flag atomically with the busy flag. This was proposed in the original PR, but we didn't have motivation to go with this implementation until a user pointed out that it improves behavior of this unlikely race window in more cases.

Commit written by Claude Sonnet 4.6, though the algorithm was originally mine, posted in the PR as a comment.
